ACTION=A3
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph towards a static obstacle located ahead at approximately 17.9 meters in a single-lane road (drivable width from -1.75m to 1.75m, escape width 3.5m) with no adjacent drivable lane available to pass around the obstacle. Therefore, the vehicle needs to decelerate and brake to a stop before hitting the obstacle. Looking at standard action space definitions for this simulation environment, A3 corresponds to braking/stopping.
